scope_rule: Keep an independently reported analysis only when its core input or inference depends on spatial omics or explicit tissue coordinates; exclude stand-alone single-cell, bulk, clinical, genetic, and pathology-only analyses.

dropped.title: Construct an integrated kidney cellular atlas
dropped.reason: Core integration uses scRNA, snRNA, and joint single-cell RNA data; spatial assays only localize cell types defined elsewhere.

dropped.title: Map cell-type chromatin and regulatory landscapes
dropped.reason: Chromatin peaks, motifs, and regulatory landscapes come from single-nucleus multi-omic data without spatial coordinates.

dropped.title: Define injury-associated cellular states
dropped.reason: Injury states are defined from scRNA, snRNA, and joint single-cell data rather than spatial inference.

dropped.title: Validate injury-state timing across species
dropped.reason: The cross-species validation projects human states onto a mouse single-cell injury time course.

dropped.title: Reconstruct proximal-tubule and loop repair trajectories
dropped.reason: Trajectory and RNA-velocity analyses operate on single-cell and single-nucleus subpopulations.

dropped.title: Infer trajectory-specific regulatory networks
dropped.reason: Regulatory-network inference integrates single-nucleus chromatin and expression without spatial input.

dropped.title: Infer repair-state-specific signaling
dropped.reason: Spatial assays motivate a niche, but the CellChat analysis itself operates on single-cell trajectory modules.

dropped.title: Associate adaptive states with kidney-failure outcomes
dropped.reason: Survival and Cox analyses use bulk-biopsy expression and clinical outcomes.

dropped.title: Validate state–diagnosis associations in an independent cohort
dropped.reason: The validation compares diagnoses in an independent bulk-biopsy expression cohort.

dropped.title: Connect repair regulation to kidney genetic risk
dropped.reason: Genetic enrichment uses GWAS, eQTL, chromatin peaks, and regulatory networks without spatial data.

dropped.title: Characterize senescent maladaptive repair
dropped.reason: Senescence and repair-state comparisons are based primarily on single-cell states and trajectories.

dropped.title: Predict treatment response in breast cancer
dropped.reason: Treatment-response prediction uses whole-slide images and bulk-level gene-expression profiles.

dropped.title: Predict colorectal cancer survival
dropped.reason: Survival prediction uses TCGA whole-slide images and whole-slide-level expression.

dropped.title: Generate and externally evaluate pathology reports
dropped.reason: The external evaluation cohort contains pathology images and reports but no spatial-omics input.
